---
title: scale-colour-discrete
subtitle: Discrete colour scale mapping categorical levels to stroke colours.
category: Scales
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---



## Usage

```typst
scale-colour-discrete(
  name: none,
  palette: auto,
  limits: none,
  labels: auto,
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `none` | Legend title. Overrides any name set via [`labs`](../labs/labs.qmd) when both are present. |
| `palette` | `auto` | Colour source: an array of colours, or `auto`. |
| `limits` | `none` | Array of level names controlling order and inclusion, or `none`. |
| `labels` | `auto` | Array of legend labels aligned with `limits`, or `auto`. |

## Returns

Scale object consumed by [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/scale-colour-discrete-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = (
  (x: 1, y: 2, sp: "a"),
  (x: 2, y: 4, sp: "b"),
  (x: 3, y: 3, sp: "c"),
)
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y", colour: "sp"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 3pt),),
  scales: (scale-colour-discrete(),),
)
```
